title: The Guncle
author: Steven Rowley
blurb: A funny, big-hearted story about a gay uncle who takes in his niece and nephew for a summer in Palm Springs. It’s full of wit and grief and heart, and you’ll laugh out loud before it quietly gets you.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
blurb: Bilbo Baggins would much rather stay home, until a wizard and thirteen dwarves drag him off on an adventure with trolls, goblins, and a dragon. It’s the classic that started it all, and it’s still a joy to read aloud.

title: Humble Pi: A Comedy of Maths Errors
author: Matt Parker
blurb: A very funny tour of the times math went wrong in real life, from collapsing bridges to confused spacecraft. You don’t need to love math to enjoy it, and you’ll leave feeling better about your own mistakes.
